claims.statement: On Saturday night, May 19, 1883, a sport at Tom Allen's saloon told a reporter a good day's sport would be had at the cock main the next morning.
claims.excerpt: into Tom Allen’s saloon Saturday night,

claims.statement: A sport offered to take the reporter to the cock main if he met him at Tom Allen's saloon at about seven the next morning.
claims.excerpt: if you meet me at Tom Allen’s I

notes: Allen appears only as the name of a saloon. The hint that the cock-fighting crowd arranged to meet there is not in the text; they met in Butchertown and went to Venice.
